provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: exact: the state is not a stabilizer state (the moduli 1/sqrt6 and 2/sqrt6 differ)

notes: Settles chi(N) = 2 with the rank-2 witness of the same cell. Exact throughout: a stabilizer state has one modulus on its support, and the moduli 1/sqrt6 and 2/sqrt6 differ, decided in sympy. The single-copy cell carries the trivial exponent and moves nothing; it is filed so the orbit page shows chi = 2 at m = 1 as it does for S, T3, and T5. Also proved in Lean 4 (PR #194, 0 sorryAx): LeanProofs.M1Lower.norrell_m1_stabRankP_gt_one (and norrell_m1_stabRank_eq_two against IsStab).
